We strongly believe that 'learning by doing' is the most effective way to master CSS.
Throughout this course, you'll learn new concepts and apply them immediately to build your project step-by-step.
As you progress through each chapter, you'll gradually develop a strong intuition for CSS by writing code and creating different parts of your project.
In the next chapter, you'll learn how to apply colors and backgrounds to your webpage.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
